summary: Added integration coverage for URL normalization on link creation, retrieval, and persistence, plus a validation failure path.
rationale: The tests exercise the approved normalization cases through the HTTP API without depending on an unprovided normalizer class or changing existing test files. Assertions use xUnit Assert methods without chaining from Assert.Single, avoiding the reported void-return build error.
content: Added a new integration test class covering mixed-case scheme and host, HTTP/HTTPS default-port removal, preservation of non-default ports and non-UTM query data, case-insensitive removal of UTM parameters, removal of an all-UTM query string, and rejection of an invalid URL without persistence.
